events.label: Whatnot Raises $545M Series G at $20B Valuation
events.summary: Whatnot raised $545 million in Series G funding, bringing its valuation to around $20 billion and making its co-founders multibillionaires.

events.label: Whatnot Opens Dublin European HQ and Plans to Double Irish Workforce
events.summary: Whatnot opened a new European headquarters on Sir Rogerson's Quay in Dublin and announced plans to hire 130 people to double its Irish workforce.
